page.notes: The Greek word after "Episcopalis" is uncertain (marked [?]); the scan is too small to read its letters with confidence. "cofruptela" and "Prorcegis" are copied as printed and may be printer's errors. "Politiâ" carries a diacritic I read as a circumflex; it may be a macron. A few small asterisk-like marks in the text are reference ornaments, not notes. The line-end "fla-" continues on the next page.
